manual_findings.finding: Whole builtin copies of host and arbitrary flat primitive DAG are structurally checked: exact host binding, native constructors/signature/scope, separately namespaced opaque IDs, strict prior node refs, ordered primitive arity, exact original Gamma indexes, output formulas and opaque origins. No native inference/rule/proof verification occurs, so even SEARCH_DERIVATION or purported verified-origin metadata supplies no proof authority.

Round-robin anchors grow backward ordered ancestor prefixes; source topology is restored for the descriptor body. Every ordered use remains in boundary_edge_map, including repeated edges. One external ref has one boundary port; repeated refs retain ordered multiplicity. Internal assumptions remain primitive body nodes; excluded assumptions/hypotheses become actual indexed Gamma ports, requiring real assumption materialization in future expansion.

Anchor and every selected node consumed outside the cut or named by original outputs are exposed, with all output labels and outgoing ordered consumer uses. Complete original request retains pass-through external outputs. Deduplicated exact selected-node cuts do not erase a different anchor: each cut consists only of one anchor and its strict ancestors, making that anchor the unique maximal source-order node in the cut.

TERM/FORMULA repeated fragments are grouped by full literal native fragment and bound/free name class; lexical bound IDs, explicit formal argument dependencies and external free allowances are retained. A native shadowing quantifier is placed in an opaque formula abstraction rather than silently alpha-renamed. Reusing a scope-class abstraction across lexical binder IDs passes the current binder IDs as explicit arguments. Symbols and LITERAL rule arguments remain literal. Fresh independent ground roundtrip remains required; no universal lemma claim follows.

Emitted ordinary descriptorV2 uses fresh ASCII step/port/variable/meta IDs, dependency-free full primitive bodies, existing typed argument wrappers, original root binding, complete substitution, output bindings and full preimage equality census. This is schema-compatible in structure with f32e/4358, but no dynamic expansion/check is executed here. Same family ID occurrences retain separate origin/cut/maps rather than discarding provenance.

Original external input sharing policies are preserved; distinct cut-node identities are conservative DISTINCT ports and repeated identical refs share one port. Physical full-key aliasing is outside syntax mining and must be rechecked in adapter3. source_port_bindings is origin-roundtrip data: mined-cut sources are not the actual six-rule row/source schema, and even occupied source metadata never has fact_accepted true.

All proposal prefixes and catalogue/cut/family/fragment bounds remain heuristic. Literal extraction precedes optional repeated-fragment work; completed records can survive later own quota interruption. mining_complete is always false, so UNKNOWN/empty/prefix never establishes family absence, degree, EOF or pruning. _Work wraps external callback exceptions and public endpoints rethrow the identical original object; only private own unfinished work is converted to a proposal-only prefix.

No actual engine batch or row_assignment is produced. A future authenticated caller must dedup a selected registry by full descriptor preimages while keeping occurrence records, choose physical rows, replace every current external source/occupancy from the real checked state, then freshly expand/check/adapt the full instance. Current consumer2 cannot consume miner records directly; origin source_port_bindings cannot be passed as current physical facts. This is a declared integration boundary, not a hidden native admission or proof route.

review_method: Whole445-line Source, current contract/handoff/earlyAPI/operative clarifications read; full empty-parent addition/removal/actual patches and dependency capsules raw checked, AST and compile-without-evaluation only. Relevant producer template/abstraction/port syntax inspected as raw Source; no native, producer, checker, model, test, clock, actual or donor/target result call/read.
